definitions.gloss: later on; afterward; in a little while
definitions.explanation: A polite way to say 'later.' Used in business and formal contexts to indicate something will happen at a later time, typically within the same day.

examples.japanese: {後程|のちほど}ご{連絡|れんらく}します。
{資料|しりょう}は{後程|のちほど}お{送|おく}りいたします。
examples.english: I will send you the materials later.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しいことは{後程|のちほど}{改|あらた}めてご{説明|せつめい}させていただきます。
examples.english: I will explain the details properly at a later time.

notes:
A polite, somewhat formal adverb meaning 'later.' Very common in business Japanese, customer service, and formal spoken contexts. Typically implies the action will take place relatively soon — within hours rather than days.

REGISTER:
More formal than {後|あと}で, which is the casual equivalent. {後程|のちほど} is standard in business emails, phone calls, and formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後程|のちほど}ご{連絡|れんらく}します: I'll contact you later
- {後程|のちほど}お{送|おく}りします: I'll send it later
- {後程|のちほど}{改|あらた}めて: again at a later time (even more formal)
- {後程|のちほど}お{伺|うかが}いします: I'll visit later (humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|あと}で: later — casual, everyday equivalent
- {後日|ごじつ}: at a later date — implies a different day, more formal
- {改|あらた}めて: again, on another occasion — focuses on doing something over properly
